questions.question: When three of David's mighty men brought him water from the well at Bethlehem, what did David do with it?

answers.text: He poured it out to the LORD
He shared it with the troops

questions.question: When Israel's troops fled from the Philistines in a barley field, what did Eleazar and David do?

answers.text: Stood in the middle of the field and defended it
Chased after the troops to bring them back
Set fire to the barley and slipped away

questions.question: How did Benaiah, one of David's mighty men, defeat a huge Egyptian who held a spear like a weaver's beam?

answers.text: He snatched the spear and killed him with it
He knocked the spear away and the Egyptian ran
He called the Three to fight beside him
